name: Ethereum Classic
classificationNote: Upstream label "Bridge & Cross-Chain / Forged Proof" on a base-layer chain: reclassified as a 51%/consensus attack.
rootCause: Ethereum Classic suffered a January 2019 51% reorganization that enabled repeated double-spends on the proof-of-work chain. Public reporting placed the affected amount at 219,500 ETC. Ethereum Classic's proof-of-work consensus allowed an attacker with majority hashpower to mine a private fork, publish the heavier branch, and replace previously credited history. That let the attacker double-spend exchange deposits during the reorganization window.
